query:
DELETE
            FROM messages
            WHERE group_id = ?
                AND (is_story = 0
                    OR media_stored = 1
            )
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM webxdc_instances instance
                LEFT JOIN webxdc_apps app
                ON app.app_id = instance.app_id
                    AND app.version = instance.version
                WHERE instance.instance_id = messages.message_id
                    AND (app.one_time = 1
                        OR app.app_id IS NULL
                )
            )
